messages:
deploy-bot: ALERT: eu1/model-service canary 1.2.4 -> 1.2.4-hotfix failing health checks (5xx spike). See /deploy logs: https://deploy.internal/5255555555 :rotating_light:

michael: noticed a ramp in 502s for embeddings path ~11:22 UTC. Small percentage but user impact.

sara: can we hold traffic and triage? tagging @ops-oncall for approval to expedite hotfix deploy.

ops-oncall: oncall ack. need owner+pm signoff for fasttrack. what is risk of rollback?

emily: root cause looks like bad cache invalidation hook in 1.2.4 when key-prefix migration runs. reproducing locally now.

pranav: confirmed repro w/ local injected migration header. patch ready: revert migration check + add idempotent guard. builds green.

lina: pm here — user-facing docs unaffected. approve expedited deploy to eu1 canary if SRE + oncall run smoke tests and we pin to 1.2.4-hotfix. :white_check_mark:

michael: requested safety windows: 11:30-11:45 UTC quick window. ops: suggested canary at 5% for 5 minutes, then 20% for 10 minutes. rollback criteria: error rate > 0.5% above baseline or latency P95 +50ms.

ops-oncall: agreed. add automatic rollback to v1.2.3 if errors spike. I will watch logs.

pranav: deploying artifact tag: v1.2.4-hotfix-2026-03-21-1. build hash: a1b2c3d. smoke tests: pass.

michael: please run deploy command and pin canary.

emily: /deploy eu1 model-service canary --tag v1.2.4-hotfix-2026-03-21-1 --percent 5 --timeout 300 --pin true

deploy-bot: Deploy started by emily. Canary set to 5% in eu1. Rolling out 2/40 instances. Logs: https://deploy.internal/5255555555/logs

michael: smoke check: curl -sS https://eu1.api.redwood/model/health -> OK, small sample queries returning expected embedding hashes.

pranav: quick load test snippet: 
```
seq 1 50 | xargs -n1 -P10 -I{} curl -sS -X POST https://eu1.api.redwood/embeddings -d '{"text":"test {}"}'
```
results: 0/50 5xx. good.

sara: rolling to 20% now if everyone thumbs up.

ops-oncall: thumbs up from oncall. continue. monitoring dashboards: errors, latency, kvcache-hits.

emily: /deploy eu1 model-service canary --percent 20 --timeout 600

deploy-bot: Canary now at 20%. Auto-rollback hook armed: rollback -> v1.2.3 if 5xx_rate > 0.5% for 2m.

michael: observed baseline error 0.02%, current 0.03%. latency stable.

lina: pm note for release notes: "Fix: cache invalidation race during prefix migration causing intermittent 5xx on embeddings in EU region. Patched in v1.2.4-hotfix." Keep it short.

pranav: preparing release note snippet and CHANGELOG entry. snippet: 
"v1.2.4-hotfix (2026-03-21): Fix race in k-v cache invalidation during prefix migration. Backwards-compatible; no user action required."

ops-oncall: holding until 11:45 UTC for full rollout to prod eu1. if green we'll promote and pin.

michael: post-deploy checklist: update rollout status in #release-tracker, attach smoke test logs, update canary tag.

emily: all green at 20% after 10m. increasing to 50% and schedule promote at 11:40 UTC.

deploy-bot: Canary progress: 50% -> will complete at 11:41 UTC.

pranav: final promote command ready: /deploy eu1 model-service promote --from-tag v1.2.4-hotfix-2026-03-21-1 --to-prod --notify true

lina: approved. ensure postmortem stub created for tracking and link to PR.

ops-oncall: monitoring for 15 more minutes, agree to proceed if no regressions.

michael: thanks everyone. follow-up: create small regression test for migration path to prevent future rollouts with this missing guard. assign to pranav.

pranav: will open PR with test and add to preflight.

deploy-bot: Deploy complete. v1.2.4-hotfix promoted to prod eu1. Rollback standby configured to v1.2.3. Full logs: https://deploy.internal/5255555555/final-logs

lina: marking release notes draft as ready. will push to docs during change window. :memo:

michael: closing thread — hotfix expedited deploy successful, no rollback needed. great job all. :tada:
